en.headline: CUHK economist denies sexism after New Asia assembly remarks
en.dek: Students complained after associate professor Terence Chong's college talk used slides on the 'cost-benefit' of women 'marrying money'; he said the language was everyday Cantonese and not discriminatory.
body: Students at the Chinese University of Hong Kong's New Asia College have complained about remarks by associate professor of economics Terence Chong Tai-leung at a college assembly on Tuesday evening, saying the presentation showed gender bias.

The talk, held at Sir Run Run Shaw Hall as the college's 694th biweekly assembly under the title How to invest in your life?, drew more than a thousand registered students, according to college information cited by local reports. Students said slides included wording on the 'cost-benefit of girls marrying money' and that comments from the stage included that a high grade-point average was of little use to women and that women should think twice about pursuing a doctorate.

Several students said they had written to the university's Panel Against Discrimination and Sexual Harassment and to college and university offices, asking for an investigation and a public apology. Hong Kong 01 and Oriental Daily reported the complaints on Wednesday morning.

Responding to media enquiries on Tuesday, Chong denied discriminating against women. He said he had analysed the topic from more than one angle, that he supported equality between men and women, and that the same colloquial phrase could apply in either direction. He said that if the slides had made students uncomfortable he agreed they could be revised, but he did not answer when asked whether he would apologise.
The university had not issued a public statement on the complaints by Wednesday morning.

zh.headline: 新亞周會「釣金龜」言論惹投訴 莊太量否認歧視女性
zh.dek: 中大經濟系副教授、新亞書院副院長莊太量周二晚會上以「伴侶經濟學」作題，學生指簡報及發言帶性別定型並向校方投訴；他否認歧視，稱屬日常廣東話。
body: 香港中文大學新亞書院學生投訴，經濟系副教授兼書院副院長莊太量周二晚在書院周會上的發言及簡報帶有性別定型，部分學生已向校方防止歧視及性騷擾小組提出申訴。
據報該場為新亞書院第694次雙周會，晚上6時30分至8時15分在邵逸夫堂舉行，講題為「How to invest in your life?」（如何投資你的人生？）。書院資料顯示全院登記學生逾千人。學生指簡報出現「女孩子釣金龜的成本效益」等字眼，並引述台上有「女人GPA高都無用，最後都係要釣金龜」及勸喻女性慎讀博士等說法。
多名學生其後在社交平台公開投訴信，要求莊太量公開道歉，並促請大學及書院調查其是否適合繼續擔任副院長。《香港01》及東方日報周三早上均有報道。
莊太量周二回覆傳媒時否認歧視女性，稱一直主張男女平等，當日是從不同角度分析，並指「男仔都可以釣女金龜，女仔都可以釣男金龜」，屬日常廣東話用法。他表示若簡報令學生感到不適，同意作出修改，但未有正面回應應否道歉。
截至周三上午，中大尚未就投訴公開回應。
